name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-vi-aria-di-mezzo-carattere
title: Final Fantasy VI - Aria di Mezzo Carattere
description:
This is the emotional piece sung by Celes while impersonating the opera singer Maria. It could be used for a cutscene.

Note that the song doesn't loop (you can make it loop by removing "#option NoLoop" at the top of the file).
